case_name: Union of India and others v Ramesh Gandhi
respondent:
Ramesh Gandhi
Supreme Court of India

14 November 2011
Cr.A. No. 1356 of 2004
The Judgment was delivered by : Jasti Chelameswar, J.
1. This appeal arises out of a judgment of the High Court of Calcutta dated 23rd November, 2001 in Writ Petition No. 352/2001. The appellants herein were the respondents in the above-mentioned Writ Petition.
2. An FIR came to be registered on 15th November, 2000 in the Delhi Special Police Establishment, Ranchi Branch in Crime No. RC 13(A)/2000 (R) under Section 120B read with S. 420 IPC and S. 13(2) read with S. 13(1)(d) of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 against nine accused of whom the first accused was the Coal Controller at the relevant point of time. The next five accused were the officers of Central Coalfields Limited (hereinafter 'CCL'. for short), which is a subsidiary of Coal India Limited (hereinafter 'CIL', for short).
